mentions.name: VideoToBe
mentions.description: Audio and video transcription service with an AI chat layer. It transcribes recordings using Whisper and lets users chat with their recordings instead of rewatching them.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on VideoToBe — a audio and video Transcription service with an AI chat layer. Whisper for transcription, then you can chat with your recordings instead of rewatching.
